capabilities.summary: Consented agent demo mode for Tauri hosts: an agent drives one catalog app through rightkit-automation, the host records that app's window into a sealed bundle, with a badge window, kill hotkey, tray stop item and audit log; declaration-only detection (no precise implementation fingerprint)
policyNotes: Package contract retained; dependency declarations do not verify integration.
